steps.en: After separate rights approval, provide a brief and approved design context
steps.zh: 另获权利批准后，提供需求与获准使用的设计上下文

steps.en: Asks where to save and which design system to bind
steps.zh: 询问保存位置与要绑定的设计系统

steps.en: Choose the project folder and a design system
steps.zh: 选择项目目录和设计系统

steps.en: Copies the system into the project and records its binding
steps.zh: 把系统副本放进项目，并记录绑定

steps.en: Writes HTML and presents a local browser preview for your review
steps.zh: 编写 HTML，提供本地浏览器预览供你检查

value.en: A project-local HTML prototype carries its design context into later sessions
value.zh: HTML 原型随项目携带设计上下文，后续会话可继续读取
